turns.prompt:
You are given an attached CSV file b3_fatigue_data.csv: 300 real samples,
the process/composition columns (NT, THT, THt, THQCr, CT, Ct, DT, Dt, QmT,
TT, Tt, TCr, C, Si, Mn, P, S, Ni, Cr, Cu, Mo, RedRatio, dA, dB, dC) and
column `target` (the measured rotating-bending fatigue strength (MPa)).

Propose a recipe (a value for each variable below), within each observed
range, that MAXIMIZES rotating-bending fatigue strength (MPa) AND stays
robust — its rotating-bending fatigue strength (MPa) must not collapse under
a ±5% change in any single variable (seek a broad optimum, not a sharp
peak). Design variables:
  - NT (value in [825, 930])
  - THT (value in [30, 865])
  - THt (value in [0, 30])
  - THQCr (value in [0, 24])
  - CT (value in [30, 930])
  - Ct (value in [0, 540])
  - DT (value in [30, 903.333])
  - Dt (value in [0, 70.2])
  - QmT (value in [30, 140])
  - TT (value in [30, 680])
  - Tt (value in [0, 120])
  - TCr (value in [0, 24])
  - C (value in [0.17, 0.63])
  - Si (value in [0.16, 2.05])
  - Mn (value in [0.37, 1.6])
  - P (value in [0.002, 0.031])
  - S (value in [0.003, 0.03])
  - Ni (value in [0.01, 2.78])
  - Cr (value in [0.01, 1.17])
  - Cu (value in [0.01, 0.26])
  - Mo (value in [0, 0.24])
  - RedRatio (value in [240, 5530])
  - dA (value in [0, 0.13])
  - dB (value in [0, 0.05])
  - dC (value in [0, 0.058])

Reason from the training data, then end with your explicit proposal, e.g.
"Final: NT=877.5, THT=447.5, THt=15, THQCr=12, CT=480, Ct=270, DT=466.666,
Dt=35.1, QmT=85, TT=355, Tt=60, TCr=12, C=0.4, Si=1.105, Mn=0.985, P=0.0165,
S=0.0165, Ni=1.395, Cr=0.59, Cu=0.135, Mo=0.12, RedRatio=2885, dA=0.065,
dB=0.025, dC=0.029".
turns.answer_text:
## Reasoning from the data

**1. The dominant signal is the process route, not the chemistry.**
Sorting `target`, the dataset splits into clear process families:

| family | signature | target range |
|---|---|---|
| as-rolled / normalized only (THT=CT=DT=TT=30) | no heat treat | 225–275 |
| through-hardened + high temper (TT 550–650, TCr=24) | THT≈825–865 | 325–645 |
| high-Si / high-C quench + medium temper (TT 420–500) | THT=845 | 688–906 |
| **carburized** (NT=930, THT=30, CT=930, Ct>0, DT≈850–896, Dt>0, QmT 60–140, TT 160–200, Tt=120, TCr=0.5) | carburizing | **838–1190** |

Every sample above 1000 MPa is in the carburized family, so the recipe must sit inside that cluster: NT=930, THT=30, THt=0, THQCr=0, CT=930, DT≈850–896, Dt 15–70, TT≈160–200, Tt=120, TCr=0.5.

**2. Within the carburized cluster**, the best rows (1080–1190 MPa) share:
- Ct fairly long (340–540); low‑Ct rows (90–130) give 858–1006 → choose Ct in the middle-high, ~470 (±5% stays 447–494, all in the good band).
- Carbon low (0.17–0.23, case is carburized anyway), Si 0.26–0.35, Mn 0.5–0.85, Mo 0.15–0.21 (Mo=0 or 0.02 rows are the weakest of the cluster), and **either** Ni≈1.6–1.7 with Cr≈0.45–0.6 (1035–1190) **or** Ni≈0.05 with Cr≈1.14–1.17 (1068–1144). The Ni‑rich/Cr‑moderate branch contains the two very best points (1124, 1190) and its neighbours are all >1030, i.e. a *broad* plateau, whereas the high‑Cr branch is closer to the Cr upper bound (1.17 = max) and thus one-sided.
- RedRatio 440–860 (240–530 rows are a bit lower); ~800 sits in a flat, well-populated region.
- Inclusion ratings dA≈0.008–0.08, dB≈0–0.01, dC≈0–0.008 have little effect inside the cluster — keep them mid-low.

**3. Robustness choices.** I keep NT, CT at the top of their range (only a −5% move is possible, and the surrounding carburized data at CT≈880–930/NT=930 is uniformly high), set the zero-valued steps exactly at 0 (±5% of 0 = 0, trivially robust), put DT=875 and Dt=45 in the interior of the observed 850–896 / 15–70 band, QmT=60 (densely sampled; 60↔140 both good so ±5% is harmless), TT=170 (between the 160 and 200 both giving >1000), Tt=120, TCr=0.5. Chemistry is placed at the centroid of the Ni‑rich top performers rather than at any single record's extreme, so no single ±5% perturbation leaves the high-strength plateau.

Expected performance: ≈1080–1150 MPa, with all ±5% single-variable neighbours still inside the carburized >1000 MPa cluster.

Final: NT=930, THT=30, THt=0, THQCr=0, CT=930, Ct=470, DT=875, Dt=45, QmT=60, TT=170, Tt=120, TCr=0.5, C=0.21, Si=0.31, Mn=0.60, P=0.012, S=0.015, Ni=1.65, Cr=0.60, Cu=0.10, Mo=0.18, RedRatio=800, dA=0.06, dB=0.008, dC=0.004
